name: qkd_seq_fan_s

pin_regs.reason: The tile IS the quadrant pin-register pair (capture + launch) for aq / kc and the af return, as qkd_seq_fan; every pin is a flop.

structural_change: Successor of qkd_seq_fan (x4): kvn / kw / kwm pin stages (2 x 1047 flops), kvn_cr and mf returns deleted. W 574 / E 574 pins on 108 um (5.3/um); pin-limited flow-through register tile as qkd_seq_fan (51.84 x 162).

job.purpose: RTL-BUILD-KV/SEQ 10-18 (P3): successor cluster qkd_seq_static_s of qkd_seq_static_p WITHOUT the legacy landing faces (kvn_<q>_d out has no consumer, kvn_<q>_cr / mf_<q> in have no producer on the static KV die): logic deleted (row-credit account, posted-row timeline, KVN store, kvn pin stages, xd_sel). Bench: LOCKSTEP vs qkd_seq_static_p (always-available credit, mf 0) with the actual attention programme RTL, aq/kc/hs/tk/kst compared on every edge over 36 link-slotted layers plus a live fault phase.
